title: Wes as the youngest at home and everybody's favorite
summary: Wes kept going to school, was treated specially as the youngest in their father's house, and was loved for his personality.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, Wes continued going. Wes was like the youngest. However, there was still two younger than Wes but they were Buddy and my sister Lena. But they lived with my mother, you see, so Wes was the youngest there. So you know how it is with the youngest. They get sort of like a special treatment. And he was pretty smart. He learned how to get in and out of things; he was pretty shifty about that.

But very likeable. Far back as I can remember, everybody liked Wes. They loved Wes. He had quite a personality and character even then. I remember when I was working this job, there was...let me get the timing right in my head...at the age...I remember the streets.
